from pathlib import Path
import json,math,subprocess,sys,re
import numpy as np,soundfile as sf
from PIL import Image,ImageDraw,ImageFont,ImageOps
from functools import lru_cache
from render_support import speech_engine,phonemes
ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
W,H,FPS,SR=720,1280,24,24000
SPEECH=[
('LUCARIO vs MACHAMP',"Lucario faces Machamp. Let's see how this battle plays out.",'FULL HEALTH / BEFORE THE BATTLE'),
('SWORDS DANCE',"Faster Lucario uses Swords Dance, doubling physical Attack. Its Special Attack stays unchanged.",'ATTACK +2 / SPEED 216 vs 146'),
('ICE PUNCH',"Machamp tries coverage. Ice Punch is resisted by Steel and removes only nine percent.",'100% BASE ACC / ICE RESISTED'),
('AURA SPHERE',"Lucario chooses Aura Sphere. Fighting gets same-type bonus and hits neutrally. Thirty percent lost, but Swords Dance cannot boost this special move.",'NO ACCURACY CHECK / SPECIAL ATTACK'),
('CLOSE COMBAT',"Machamp switches to Close Combat. Fighting exploits Lucario’s Steel weakness: eighty-seven percent gone. Lucario survives on thirteen HP. Machamp lowers both defenses.",'100% BASE ACC / 2x EFFECTIVE'),
('EXTREME SPEED',"Extreme Speed has plus-two priority, ahead of Bullet Punch. Boosted physical damage hits lowered Defense for forty-two percent. Machamp still has one hundred five HP.",'PRIORITY +2 / PHYSICAL / NEUTRAL'),
('BULLET PUNCH',"Machamp’s Bullet Punch is resisted, but takes Lucario’s last thirteen HP.",'PRIORITY +1 / STEEL RESISTED'),
('MACHAMP WINS',"Machamp wins with twenty-seven percent health. The lesson: match your setup to your attack. These were planned choices, not perfect play.",'WINNER: MACHAMP / LUCARIO: FAINTED')]
@lru_cache(None)
def font(n):return ImageFont.truetype('/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSans-Bold.ttf',n)
def wrap(d,text,y,size=30,color='white',width=650):
 lines=[];line=''
 for word in text.split():
  trial=(line+' '+word).strip()
  if d.textlength(trial,font=font(size))>width and line:lines.append(line);line=word
  else:line=trial
 if line:lines.append(line)
 for l in lines:d.text(((W-d.textlength(l,font=font(size)))/2,y),l,font=font(size),fill=color,stroke_width=1,stroke_fill='#070e1e');y+=size+9
 return y

def voice():
 engine=speech_engine();pieces=[];timeline=[];start=0
 for i,(title,text,note) in enumerate(SPEECH):
  seg=[];captions=[];cursor=0
  for phrase in re.split(r'(?<=[.!?])\s+',text):
   a,sr=engine.create(phonemes(phrase,engine),voice='am_michael',speed=1.18,lang='en-us',is_phonemes=True,sentence_pause=.14,clause_pause=.08)
   a=np.concatenate([a,np.zeros(round(.1*SR),np.float32)])
   captions.append(dict(text=phrase,start=cursor,duration=len(a)/SR));cursor+=len(a)/SR;seg.append(a)
  a=np.concatenate(seg+[np.zeros(round(.16*SR),np.float32)])
  frames=math.ceil(len(a)/SR*FPS);a=np.pad(a,(0,round(frames/FPS*SR)-len(a)))
  timeline.append(dict(index=i,title=title,text=text,note=note,start=start,duration=len(a)/SR,captions=captions));start+=len(a)/SR;pieces.append(a)
 sf.write(ROOT/'narration.wav',np.concatenate(pieces),SR)
 (ROOT/'story.json').write_text(json.dumps(dict(title='Lucario vs Machamp: The Setup That Boosted the Wrong Move',duration=start,segments=timeline),indent=2))
 print('DURATION',start,flush=True)

def frame(scene,art,t,b,total):
 i=scene['index'];p=t/scene['duration'];im=ImageOps.fit(art,(W,H),Image.Resampling.LANCZOS)
 z=1+.035*p;im=ImageOps.fit(im.resize((round(W*z),round(H*z))), (W,H),centering=(.5,.5))
 layer=Image.new('RGBA',(W,H));d=ImageDraw.Draw(layer)
 d.rectangle((0,0,W,155),fill=(6,12,25,240));d.rectangle((0,930,W,H),fill=(6,12,25,238))
 im=Image.alpha_composite(im.convert('RGBA'),layer);d=ImageDraw.Draw(im)
 d.text((25,12),'LUCARIO vs MACHAMP',font=font(24),fill='white')
 if i==0:before=after=b['initial']
 elif i==7:before=after=b['turns'][-1]['after']
 else:before=b['events'][i-1]['before'];after=b['events'][i-1]['after']
 mix=max(0,min(1,(t-.35)/.9))
 for j,(a,z) in enumerate(zip(before,after)):
  x=25+j*365;hp=a['hp']+(z['hp']-a['hp'])*mix;pct=100*hp/a['max_hp']
  d.text((x,52),a['name'].upper(),font=font(20),fill='white');d.text((x+220,52),f'{round(pct)}%',font=font(22),fill='#ffdc86')
  d.rounded_rectangle((x,85,x+300,102),radius=6,fill='#334052')
  if pct>0:d.rounded_rectangle((x,85,x+max(2,300*pct/100),102),radius=6,fill='#73e6a3')
  d.text((x,115),' / '.join(a['types']).upper(),font=font(15),fill='#d7e2ef')
 label='FACE-OFF' if i==0 else ('RESULT' if i==7 else f"ROUND {b['events'][i-1]['turn']} / 3")
 d.rounded_rectangle((25,175,250,220),radius=8,fill='#0c1728',outline='#f9cf75',width=2);d.text((40,185),label,font=font(23),fill='white')
 if i==7:
  d.rounded_rectangle((25,245,450,345),radius=8,fill='#0c1728');d.text((40,260),'WINNER: MACHAMP',font=font(30),fill='#f9cf75');d.text((40,305),'LUCARIO: FAINTED / 0 HP',font=font(24),fill='white')
 wrap(d,scene['title'],950,32,'#ffdb81');wrap(d,scene['note'],1000,19,'#a8ddff')
 cap=scene['captions'][-1]
 for c in scene['captions']:
  if c['start']<=t<c['start']+c['duration']:cap=c;break
 words=cap['text'].split();chunks=[' '.join(words[k:k+6]) for k in range(0,len(words),6)];q=max(0,min(.999,(t-cap['start'])/cap['duration']));wrap(d,chunks[int(q*len(chunks))],1070,35)
 d.rectangle((25,1200,695,1205),fill='#334052');d.rectangle((25,1200,25+670*(scene['start']+t)/total,1205),fill='#f9cf75')
 d.text((25,1230),'LV100 / GEN9 NATIONAL DEX / NO ITEMS',font=font(17),fill='white');d.text((25,1258),'PLANNED CHOICES / ENGINE-RESOLVED DAMAGE',font=font(14),fill='#b4c4d9')
 return im.convert('RGB')
def render():
 story=json.loads((ROOT/'story.json').read_text());b=json.loads((ROOT/'battle.json').read_text());paths=json.loads((ROOT/'images.json').read_text());out=ROOT/'lucario-machamp-tactical.mp4'
 proc=subprocess.Popen(['ffmpeg','-hide_banner','-loglevel','error','-y','-f','rawvideo','-pix_fmt','rgb24','-s','720x1280','-r','24','-i','pipe:0','-i',str(ROOT/'narration.wav'),'-c:v','libx264','-preset','veryfast','-crf','20','-pix_fmt','yuv420p','-c:a','aac','-b:a','160k','-af','loudnorm=I=-16:TP=-1.5:LRA=9','-movflags','+faststart','-shortest',str(out)],stdin=subprocess.PIPE)
 for s,path in zip(story['segments'],paths):
  art=Image.open(path).convert('RGB')
  for n in range(round(s['duration']*FPS)):
   im=frame(s,art,n/FPS,b,story['duration']);proc.stdin.write(im.tobytes())
   if n==24:im.save(ROOT/f"review-{s['index']}.jpg")
 proc.stdin.close();rc=proc.wait();assert rc==0
 print(out,flush=True)
if __name__=='__main__':render() if '--render' in sys.argv else voice()

description:
Lucario faces Machamp in a three-round tactical teaching example. Every actual move is shown in engine order after a short full-health face-off introduction.

Planned teaching choices, with damage and effects resolved by Pokemon Showdown 0.11.11, Generation 9 National Dex. This is not perfect play, a canon anime result, a species ranking or an aggregate win probability.

Lucario: Fighting/Steel, level 100, Steadfast, Bold, 252 HP / 252 Defense / 4 Special Attack EVs; Swords Dance, Aura Sphere, Extreme Speed, Close Combat. Machamp: Fighting, level 100, Guts, Serious, 252 HP / 252 Defense / 4 Attack EVs; Ice Punch, Close Combat, Bullet Punch, Stone Edge. Both: 31 IVs, no items, switching, Mega Evolution or Tera. Neither ability activates in this sequence. Fixed seed: 48966, 19465, 42084, 12090.

Lucario is faster (216 vs 146). Swords Dance doubles physical Attack but cannot boost special Aura Sphere. Ice Punch is resisted by Steel; Aura Sphere is neutral Fighting STAB and does not check accuracy. Machamp's physical Fighting STAB Close Combat hits Lucario super effectively, leaving it on 13 HP, and drops Machamp's Defense and Special Defense. Extreme Speed (+2 priority) precedes Bullet Punch (+1), but cannot remove Machamp's remaining 267 HP; it removes 162. Resisted Bullet Punch then takes Lucario's last 13 HP. Machamp wins with 105/384 HP (27.3%).

Actual HP removed: Ice Punch 31/344 (9.0%); Aura Sphere 117/384 (30.5%); Close Combat 300/344 (87.2%); Extreme Speed 162/384 (42.2%); Bullet Punch 13/344 (3.8%). Spoken percentages are rounded. Other than Aura Sphere's accuracy bypass, all moves here have 100% base accuracy. Current typing stays unchanged throughout.

Original generated anime illustrations with camera movement, captions and animated HP bars; not continuous character animation.
